evidence.text: The forecast decision is already pre-released and the bar sits at its floor. On 2026-07-21 the company told analysts to expect FY OP 'closer to the lower end than the midpoint' of ¥5.0-10.0bn. IFIS consensus has moved to OP ¥5,158m and revenue ¥52,665m, below the ¥53,500m revenue floor. dip held its FY26 OP guide of ¥12.0bn unchanged at Q2 and Q3 and then delivered ¥9.1bn without filing a 修正, so holding the range (or narrowing it to the low end) is the likely outcome, and that is a relief rather than a disappointment against this bar.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only separate 修正 in four years (2024-01-11, FY24 Q3) took the stock -21.6% the next session. The new-year guide on 2026-04-14 (range OP ¥5-10bn against ¥9.1bn the year before) took it -9.4%. The held guide at Q2 FY26 (2025-10-14) took it -2.7%. Moves from Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2379.T?range=3y&interval=1d.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The low-end steer has been public for twelve weeks, consensus and the target price (¥1,754) have converged on it, and the stock is flat since. What is left is the asymmetry: a held or low-end-narrowed range against a consensus already at the floor removes the cut risk. If the market feared a cut below ¥5bn, the stock would trade below its yield floor or the margin longs would be unwinding, and neither shows.

With Q2's seasonal step down from Q1 and a full quarter of the ad push that began in May, Q2 OP looks likely to fall well short of last year's ¥2,064m, and H1 progress against even the ¥5.0bn floor looks likely to be far below the company's own 49-60% H1 share in FY24-FY26.
